conditionalMechanicalTarget.predeclaredIn: Phase 6C2C5 exercise contracts, frozen before the candidate search ran
conditionalMechanicalTarget.claim: a larger bias concentrates the mismatch possessions on its beneficiary
conditionalMechanicalTarget.whatThisEstablishes: The mechanic responds to the parameter, in the declared direction, monotonically across the full registry range, without breaching a guardrail.
conditionalMechanicalTarget.whatThisDoesNotEstablish: A magnitude. Sign and monotonicity do not select a value, so this target cannot prefer the default over any other value in range. The default is retained because nothing available can rank values, not because it was shown to be best.
conditionalMechanicalTarget.notInventedAfterResults: The contract, its conditional metrics, its guardrails and its expected direction were all written in Phase 6C2C5 before the candidate search produced any result. No target was added or re-aimed in response to a candidate outcome.

resolved.reclassificationReason: Phase 6C2C5 filed this as STRUCTURAL_CALIBRATION_ONLY, which implies a bounded search could tune it. That search then proved the only available numeric objective cannot see the parameter at all. DEFAULT_FROZEN_UNADJUDICATED states the true position: identifiable through its own mechanic, unrankable by any available target, frozen at its default.
